Annoying things to be aware of that is still a work in progress:
* the module assembly is still extremely glitchy working with the Unity physics engine. We are finding ways to make it smoother. 
* Also along with Unity physics engine, when you fly in the ship in zero-G, be aware that you might get ejected out into space and can't get back in and might have to reload last saved. Trying to stay away from the walls helps.
We are trying our best to balance between fixing known issues/polishing what we have and adding new features.

notes.title: 2nd Sandbox Mode Pre-Alpha update is out
notes.notes:
Not bad for a week worth of work! at this rate, we'll have a full functioning Sandbox in no time!
Thank you all who participate in our Pre-Alpha and being a part of our Discord channel! You guys really make our community come alive! I will do my best to make this game, a space game you've always wanted to play :)

** Things to note **
- As of this update, you still cannot fly the capital ship, we still need to work on the navigation system, A.I., and many other mechanics before we lift the curfew on the big boat
- Please take it easy on the walls and colliders during EVA flight, otherwise, you might get sucked out into space without an EVA suit!!! We are still working hard to continue to make the character system a good one. What we are trying to accomplish has not been done much before, so we kind of have to write our own book as we go sorta speak.
- Buy/Sell is coming in the next update, so as of now you still cannot sell-off or modify your modules.
- Mining is pointless at the moment since you still cannot sell what you've gathered, and there are no processing facilities. That is also coming in the next update.

notes.title: App Submitted Still Waiting For Steam to Release
notes.notes:
There thousands of new games being submitted to Steam every single month, and when we submit ours, it sits in a queue for their team to install, play through the game to check for legitimacy and for major bugs, etc to make sure you, the customer is paying for a legitimate product. This process usually takes 2-3 days or more according to SteamWorks. Again, sincere apologies, we are still new to this whole game-selling stuff. We are just a bunch of dreamers in a garage trying to make a good game :). 

We really hope you enjoy our intro mission and what's to come in later installments throughout the year! We've decided to hire professional voice actors out of our own pockets although we didn't get enough funding through Kicstarter, it would just be unbearable to only have one voice no voice at all. Really, this whole game is self-funded on top of 10,000+ hours of total man hours in a span of 4 years of development/learning in Unity (7,000+ of it was from one developer who spends every spare moment he has on developing the game out of passion and love).
